                # importance divided by next allocated position (current+1)
                score = seg['importance'] / (allocations[i] + 1)
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score

            # Should not happen if budget <= total capacity
            break
        allocations[best_idx] += 1
        total_used += 1
    # Build output
    by_name = {segments[i]['name']: allocations[i] for i in range(n)}
    return {
        'allocations': allocations,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': total_used
    }"
